A unique id for this product, used to match rows on CSV import. Auto-assigned like P-000001 if you leave it blank; you can set your own instead.

If this product comes in more than one color, create one product per color and give them all the same Color group — customers will then see color options to switch between on the product page. Leave both blank for a single-color product.
